assessments.name: Annotated bibliography
assessments.description:
Write a draft title for your project
Write 3 research questions
Write an annotated bibliography that includes twelve scholarly sources: Conceptual sources (×4), Methodological sources (×4), Field sources (x4).

assessments.description: Create a 3-minute video featuring a mix of content types that tightly presents your project's thesis (900wds equivalent per student) and one exegesis (200 words per student).
